description: The RFC 9457 JSON format for errors, with type, title, status, detail and instance members and optional extensions.
The Spring class that represents an RFC 9457 problem and renders as application/problem+json.
A class whose exception handler methods apply to every controller, so errors are mapped in one place.
A base class that renders every built-in Spring MVC exception as a problem detail and can be overridden per exception.
A stable URI in the type member that identifies a kind of error, which clients can branch on.
A custom field added to a problem response, such as an errors list or the id of the missing resource.
A handler for Exception that logs the cause on the server and returns a fixed, safe message.
